params.prompt:
SHOT: Straight-on e-commerce packshot, 4:5. ONE ring only, standing upright on the top face, the two clusters facing the camera across the opening, the broad, heavy band's width and thickness clearly visible as it curves away behind, on a cream plaster cube. Camera close, a little above the cube's top face, looking down at about thirty degrees. Macro-sharp on the metal.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is a phone photograph of the actual piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; it is a frame from the owner's video of the ring worn on a finger over a tray of rings: take ONLY the ring on the finger. IMAGE 2 shows the same ring design from above, several of them lying in the tray. IMAGE 2 is a close detail of the same piece. IMAGE 3 is here ONLY for the plinth, the camera distance, the background and the light: copy its cube and its framing exactly and ignore everything else about it.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: AN OPEN CLUSTER RING with a BROAD, HEAVY polished gold band, about 5 to 6mm wide and about 2mm thick, solid and chunky like a wide cigar band, exactly as IMAGE 1 and IMAGE 2 show, that does NOT close. Each open end is squared off and rises into a thick gold block that carries a small cluster of clear faceted stones in raised gold claws; the two clusters face each other across a narrow gap. One end carries exactly TWO stones: ONE clear PEAR, the larger, and ONE SMALLER clear ROUND, lined up end to end. The other end carries exactly TWO stones: two clear PEARS of the same size side by side, their rounded ends together and their points turned outward, with a row of tiny gold beads along the edge of the band beside them and nothing else. All stones clear. Only clear stones: one pear and one round on one end, two pears on the other; never coloured stones, never a full pave band, never a closed band. Exactly FOUR stones in all: three pears and one small round; never five stones, never four pears, never two rounds. The end with the round has one round and one pear, never two rounds; the end with the two pears has no third stone, not even a small one.

SCALE TEST: Each cluster is about 10 to 12mm across: the pears about 5x7mm, the round about 4mm; the band is about 5 to 6mm wide, nearly as wide as a pear is long, and about 2mm thick. The piece keeps its true small size against the cube, never enlarged.

GROUND: The cream plaster cube fills the lower half of the frame, large and close; flat faces, softly rounded corners, fine plaster grain. Warm cream seamless behind with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no fingers, no model, no fabric, no props, no flowers, no box. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. The picture runs edge to edge as a crisp, clean, modern digital studio photograph, shot today on a high-resolution digital camera.
